tips.label: 授與動詞
tips.text: 人先物後：give 人 物；物先人後：give 物 to 人、buy 物 for 人。

tips.label: Why 的用法
tips.text: 問原因用 Why；be 動詞放主詞前，一般動詞用 do／does／did + 主詞 + 原形動詞。

tips.label: Because 和 So
tips.text: because 後接原因；so 後接結果。同一組因果子句不要同時用 because 和 so。

tips.label: Because 和 Because of
tips.text: because + 主詞 + 動詞；because of + 名詞或名詞片語。

notes.title: 授與動詞的兩種句型
notes.rule: S + V + 人 + 物；S + V + 物 + to／for + 人
notes.description: give、send、show、write、pass 的物在前時用 to；buy、make、cook 用 for。人直接放在動詞後、物放最後時，不加介系詞。本課物用 it／them 時，採「物 + to／for + 人」。
examples: The doctor gave Ben some medicine.
The doctor gave some medicine to Ben.
Mom bought a coat for Amy.

notes.title: Why 的用法
notes.rule: Why + be 動詞 + 主詞 ...?；Why + do／does／did + 主詞 + 原形動詞 ...?
notes.description: Why 問原因。問狀態時將 be 動詞放主詞前；問一般動詞的動作時用 do、does 或 did。did／did not 後面的動詞都用原形。回答可用 Because + 原因子句。
examples: Why does Tom wear a mask every day?
Why did you call the doctor?
Why didn't Amy take her medicine?

notes.title: Because 和 So 的因果順序
notes.rule: 結果 + because + 原因；Because + 原因, 結果；原因, so + 結果
notes.description: because 帶出原因，so 帶出結果。because 子句放句首時，後面用逗號分開。同一組因果子句不寫成 Because ..., so ...。
examples: I stayed home because I had a fever.
Because I had a fever, I stayed home.
I had a fever, so I stayed home.

notes.title: Because 和 Because of 的差別
notes.rule: because + 子句；because of + 名詞／名詞片語
notes.description: 先看後面有沒有主詞與動詞。he was sick 是完整子句，用 because；his illness 是名詞片語，用 because of。不能只看中文都譯為「因為」就混用。
examples: Tom missed school because he had a fever.
Tom missed school because of his fever.
Because the weather was bad, we stayed home.
Because of the bad weather, we stayed home.

quiz.question: The doctor gave some medicine ___ the sick boy.（醫生把一些藥給了那位生病的男孩。）
quiz.hint: 授與動詞 give 把物放在人前面時，用「物 + to + 人」。

quiz.question: Mom made some soup ___ her sick daughter.（媽媽為生病的女兒煮了一些湯。）
quiz.hint: 授與動詞 make 把物放在人前面時，用「物 + for + 人」。

quiz.question: Dad sent a message ___ the nurse.（爸爸傳了一則訊息給護士。）
quiz.hint: 授與動詞 send 把物放在人前面時，用「物 + to + 人」。

quiz.question: My brother bought a warm coat ___ Grandma.（我哥哥買了一件暖和的大衣給奶奶。）
quiz.hint: 授與動詞 buy 把物放在人前面時，用「物 + for + 人」。

quiz.question: The nurse showed the health report ___ Dad.（護士把健康報告拿給爸爸看。）
quiz.hint: 授與動詞 show 把物放在人前面時，用「物 + to + 人」。

quiz.question: Grandpa cooked dinner ___ the children.（爺爺為孩子們煮晚餐。）
quiz.hint: 授與動詞 cook 把物放在人前面時，用「物 + for + 人」。

quiz.question: Lily wrote a card ___ her sick friend.（Lily 寫了一張卡片給生病的朋友。）
quiz.hint: 授與動詞 write 把物放在人前面時，用「物 + to + 人」。

quiz.question: Please pass the clean mask ___ Ben.（請把乾淨的口罩遞給 Ben。）
quiz.hint: 授與動詞 pass 把物放在人前面時，用「物 + to + 人」。

quiz.question: The doctor gave ___ some medicine.
quiz.hint: give + 人 + 物：人直接放在 gave 後，不加 to。

quiz.question: Mom bought ___ a new coat.
quiz.hint: buy + 人 + 物：人放在物前，不加 for。

quiz.question: The nurse showed ___ a picture.
quiz.hint: show + 人 + 物：人直接接在 showed 後。

quiz.question: Grandma made ___ some warm soup.
quiz.hint: make + 人 + 物：人放在物前，不加 for。

quiz.question: Dad sent ___ yesterday.（爸爸昨天寄了一張卡片給 Ben。）
quiz.hint: send + 人 + 物是 sent Ben a card；物在前則為 sent a card to Ben。

quiz.question: Amy bought ___ yesterday.（Amy 昨天買了一件大衣給媽媽。）
quiz.hint: buy 的物在前時用「物 + for + 人」。

quiz.question: The teacher gave ___ after class.（老師下課後把它給了 Tom。）
quiz.hint: 物是 it 時，本課採 give it to + 人，不用 give + 人 + it。

quiz.question: Please send ___ today.（請今天把它們寄給那位醫生。）
quiz.hint: 物是 them 時，本課採 send them to + 人。

quiz.question: A: ___ did you stay home? B: Because I had a fever.
quiz.hint: 回答提供發燒的原因，因此用 Why 問「為什麼」。

quiz.question: A: ___ is Tina wearing a mask? B: Because she has a cold.
quiz.hint: Because 引出戴口罩的原因，問句用 Why。

quiz.question: Why ___ Ben absent yesterday?
quiz.hint: absent 是形容詞，主詞 Ben 是單數；問過去的狀態用 Why was Ben ...?

quiz.question: Why ___ the children so tired last night?
quiz.hint: 問過去的狀態，複數主詞 the children 配 were。

quiz.question: Why ___ your sister stay home yesterday?
quiz.hint: stay 是一般動詞，yesterday 表示過去，問句用 Why did + 主詞 + 原形動詞。

quiz.question: Why ___ Tom wear a mask every day?
quiz.hint: 一般動詞 wear 的現在簡單式問句，單數主詞 Tom 用 does。

quiz.question: Why did you ___ the doctor last night?
quiz.hint: Why did + 主詞後面接原形動詞 call。

quiz.question: Why didn't Amy ___ her medicine this morning?
quiz.hint: Why didn't + 主詞後面仍接原形動詞 take。

quiz.question: Why ___ at home yesterday?（你昨天為什麼在家？）
quiz.hint: 含 be 動詞的 Why 問句把 were 放在主詞 you 前。

quiz.question: A: Why did Sam miss class? B: ___ he had a bad headache.
quiz.hint: Why 問原因；回答用 Because + 主詞 + 動詞。

quiz.question: I stayed in bed ___ I had a fever.（依因果關係選出答案。）
quiz.hint: 前面是在床上休息的結果，後面是發燒的原因。

quiz.question: My knee hurt, ___ I stopped running.（依因果關係選出答案。）
quiz.hint: 膝蓋痛是原因，停止跑步是結果。

quiz.question: ___ her throat hurt, Anna drank some warm water.（依因果關係選出答案。）
quiz.hint: 句首先說喉嚨痛的原因，再說喝溫水的結果。

quiz.question: Dad was sick, ___ he rested at home.（依因果關係選出答案。）
quiz.hint: 先說生病的原因，再用 so 接在家休息的結果。

quiz.question: Lily put on a coat ___ she felt cold.（依因果關係選出答案。）
quiz.hint: 覺得冷是穿大衣的原因，原因子句前用 because。

quiz.question: The bus broke down, ___ we walked to school.（依因果關係選出答案。）
quiz.hint: 公車故障是原因，走路上學是結果。

quiz.question: Peter missed the bus ___ he got up late.（依因果關係選出答案。）
quiz.hint: 起床晚是錯過公車的原因。

quiz.question: My arm hurt, ___ I asked the doctor for help.（依因果關係選出答案。）
quiz.hint: 手臂痛是原因，求助醫生是結果。

quiz.question: Because Ben had a fever, ___ stayed home.
quiz.hint: 同一組因果子句用 because 或 so 其中一個連接即可；不要重複加入連接詞。

quiz.question: Amy had a sore throat, so ___ drank warm water.
quiz.hint: 同一組因果子句用 because 或 so 其中一個連接即可；不要重複加入連接詞。

quiz.question: ___ the rain was heavy, we stayed inside.（依因果關係選出答案。）
quiz.hint: 句首原因子句用 Because，後面直接接主要子句。

quiz.question: The store was closed, ___ we could not buy any masks.（依因果關係選出答案。）
quiz.hint: 商店關門是原因，無法買口罩是結果。

quiz.question: Tom missed school ___ his fever.
quiz.hint: his fever 是名詞片語。原因是名詞片語時用 because of。

quiz.question: Tom missed school ___ he had a fever.
quiz.hint: he had a fever 是有主詞和動詞的子句。原因是完整子句時用 because。

quiz.question: The game was canceled ___ the heavy rain.
quiz.hint: the heavy rain 是名詞片語。原因是名詞片語時用 because of。

quiz.question: The game was canceled ___ it rained heavily.
quiz.hint: it rained heavily 是完整子句。原因是完整子句時用 because。

quiz.question: Kevin could not sleep ___ his headache.
quiz.hint: his headache 是名詞片語。原因是名詞片語時用 because of。

quiz.question: Kevin could not sleep ___ his head hurt.
quiz.hint: his head hurt 是完整子句。原因是完整子句時用 because。

quiz.question: ___ the bad weather, we stayed home.
quiz.hint: the bad weather 是名詞片語。原因是名詞片語時用 because of。

quiz.question: ___ the weather was bad, we stayed home.
quiz.hint: the weather was bad 是完整子句。原因是完整子句時用 because。

quiz.question: Mary stayed home because ___.
quiz.hint: because 後接完整子句 she was sick，不能直接接名詞片語。

quiz.question: Mary stayed home because of ___.
quiz.hint: because of 後接名詞片語 her illness，不能直接接完整子句。

quiz.question: The boy walked slowly because ___.
options: A. the pain in his leg
quiz.hint: because 後需接有主詞、動詞的子句 his knee hurt。

quiz.question: The boy walked slowly because of ___.
quiz.hint: because of 後接名詞片語 his sore knee。
